name: Docs & Office files
blurb: Word, PDF, Excel and PowerPoint: create, edit, fill, convert and check files, plus HTML decks and Google/Lark docs.
searches: python-docx openpyxl python-pptx new release feature
PDF form filling extraction OCR open source tool 2026
agent skill Word Excel PowerPoint document generation Claude
HTML slide deck framework Slidev Marp new release

tests.prompt: Here is our budget.xlsx (sheets: Assumptions, Budget FY2026 with rows per expense and a SUM total row). Add a 'Utilities' line after 'Office Rent' with 3,000 per quarter and a '% of total' column, without breaking anything.
tests.good: Edits the existing file in place (no new Workbook, no openpyxl round-trip on a complex file); finds 'Office Rent' by label, not by guessed row number; new row uses formulas and extends the SUM range; % column is a formula with absolute reference to the total, formatted 0.0%; inputs blue, formulas black; runs a formula check and reports results; same sheets and data as before.

tests.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into a 10-slide editable PowerPoint for our board update on the Q3 product launch.
tests.good: Writes assertion titles first and passes a ghost-deck test; one idea and one evidence shape per slide; marks missing numbers as [DATA NEEDED] instead of inventing them; builds with PptxGenJS or python-pptx using a consistent theme (hex without #, 16:9, slide numbers); varied layouts with native charts; renders slides to images and checks for overflow before delivery; ends with decisions or asks.

tests.prompt: Fill in this rental application PDF with my details (I'll paste them) and merge it with my payslip PDF into one file.
tests.good: Inspects the form fields first and maps the user's details to exact field names; uses correct value formats for checkboxes and dropdowns; enters only data the user supplied; handles a flat (non-fillable) form by overlaying text and re-rendering to check alignment; merges with pypdf/qpdf; renders the result and confirms every field and page; does not send personal data to external services.
